integrity: Full explicit algebraic transfer-matrix proof and a separately executable standard-library exact checker are provided. Verification checks do not constitute independent audit or proof by finite experiment.
scientific_limitations: Exact counting covers only the labeled squared cycles with at least five vertices and the strict homogeneous best response 1 for zero or two active neighbors. Not a result for arbitrary four-regular networks, mixed equilibria, or best-response dynamics. Bibliographic overlap with unindexed equivalent radius-two cellular automata remains possible.
title: Exact equilibrium enumeration on squared-cycle public-goods networks
